name: wp-ja-kinetic/post-readtime
title: Post read time
description: The source's per-row "N min" reading estimate (`kinetic_blog_readtime()`/`kinetic_au_readtime()`, ~200 wpm): no core block computes one, so this reads the current loop post's content directly. Attributes select the source's own output shapes: plain "N min" (blog rows, template.css `.hx-blogread`), "N min read" (article meta line), or with `dateFormat` the author row's whole "Jul 8 · 2 min" meta line (`author_posts.php:44`).
